tests.name: Category overview is a six-item icon grid with four selectable departments and no side rail
Icon selection expands matching subcategories and subcategory browsing opens filtered products
All pieces, offers, camera, search and bestseller discovery remain actionable
Invalid category selection cannot corrupt the department panel
Paid variants aggregate by product and orderCount counts each order once
Only paid supported fulfillment states count; pending, failed and legacy status/payment flags are ignored
Nonexistent product IDs and invalid quantities are ignored instead of becoming product 1
Duplicate order IDs are counted once and tied products use stable product ID order
Ranking is read-only and respects a home limit without padding with zero-sale products
Preview home shows honest paid-order ranking, demonstration label and a working more route
Full bestseller collection shows all ranked items and discloses local-only statistics
No eligible orders produces a truthful empty state with a recovery shopping link
Completing and cancelling a local order updates quantity ranking on the next render

limits: Actual app scripts evaluated in isolated VM. These checks verify category routes, handlers and ranking semantics, not browser appearance, actual device behavior or production-wide sales. No new sales fixture was added to the shipped app. Ranking means original quantities ordered in paid, non-cancelled orders; it does not subtract after-sales return quantities or claim net retained sales. Synthetic returned/refunded flags in the robustness fixture test unsupported legacy status/payment values, not the app after-sales lifecycle.
